"""只读复核30686的实体边界；不提交表单或上传文件。"""
import html,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
import repair_gmyhf_sample_findings as helper
class Visible(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.parts=[]
    def handle_data(self,d):self.parts.append(d)
def render(s):
    p=Visible();p.feed(s);return ''.join(p.parts)
root=Path.cwd();before=json.loads(Path('/tmp/gmyhf-statement-repairs-batch8/before/30686/form.json').read_text())
session=helper.platform.oj_submit.Session().login()
page=session._get(helper.platform.oj_submit.HOST+'/admin/problems/edit/?id=30686')
current=helper.platform.parse_form(page)
assert helper.fingerprint(current)==helper.fingerprint(before)
evidence=root/'collab/gmyhf-pending-batch15-review.json'
entry=next(e for e in json.loads(evidence.read_text())['entries'] if e['global_number']==30686)
assert {k:helper.sha(html.unescape(before[k]).encode()) for k in helper.FIELDS}==entry['checks']['statement']['field_sha256']
ns={};exec(entry['authored_reference']['source'].split('import sys\nsys.stdout.write')[0],ns)
rows=[]
for mode,s in [('single_html_parse',before['sampleInput']),('extra_unescape_before_html_parse',html.unescape(before['sampleInput']))]:
    visible=render(s)
    samples=re.split(r'sample[123]:\s*',visible)
    assert len(samples)==4 and not samples[0].strip()
    answers=[ns['tag_valid'](p.strip()) for p in samples[1:]]
    rows.append({'method':mode,'visible_sha256':helper.sha(visible.encode()),'reference_answers':answers,
                 'sample_input_sha256':[helper.sha(p.strip().encode()) for p in samples[1:]]})
assert rows[0]['reference_answers']==['true','true','false']
assert rows[1]['reference_answers']==['false','false','false']
assert '<DIV>' in before['sampleInput'] and '<DIV>' not in before['sampleInput']
public=Path('/tmp/gmyhf-30686-public.html').read_bytes()
source=Path(__file__).read_text()
report={'global_number':30686,'scope':'后台原文的只读实体解析复核，不是公开页面渲染已验证的声明。',
        'evidence':str(evidence.relative_to(root)),'evidence_sha256':helper.sha(evidence.read_bytes()),
        'admin_form_sha256':helper.fingerprint(before),'admin_form_unchanged':True,
        'original_statement_fields_match_audit':True,'reference_sha256':entry['authored_reference']['sha256'],
        'comparisons':rows,'platform_writes':0,
        'finding':'一次HTML解析保留实体中的代码标签，三样例为true/true/false；先额外unescape再剥HTML会造成原审核的false/false/false。不能据此重写已转义的原文。',
        'public_route':{'url':'http://cs101.openjudge.cn/practice/30686/','response_sha256':helper.sha(public),
                        'problem_content_verified':False,'observation':'返回OpenJudge登录入口，未得到题目正文。'},
        'next_step':'暂缓题面写入；若继续核实际显示，应使用可访问的课程题目路由确认渲染层。',
        'procedure_sha256':helper.sha(source.encode()),'procedure_source':source}
helper.save(root/'collab/gmyhf-30686-display-recheck.json',report)
print('后台表单保持；一次解析样例true/true/false，重复解码后false/false/false；零写入。')
